steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: The plan worked, Chief. I took a gamble, believing she'd slow down to spend more time with you... Hehe, I was right.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Thus, the virus I planted in your body successfully infected her. This would have been impossible given her level of vigilance.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Chief, thank you for being my bait.
As she says this, Moore deploys another matrix around you, shielding you from the information turbulence and giving you room to breathe.
What did you do?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Oh, right, you're still here. Almost forgot.
Moore turns to 000, inspecting her own work contentedly.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Don't worry. A simple trap like this won't hurt you. The defense system in this world has been putting a lot of pressure on you, hasn't it? I simply built on that.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: From a programming perspective, as an anomaly, you exploited a unique loophole, breaking through the dimensional firewall and delving deep into the system. You've proven your ability to disrupt the system's underlying logic. That's impressive.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: But errors are not uncommon. A so-called "world" remains stable despite its vastness precisely because it has extremely powerful error-correcting capabilities.
As she says this, an endearing smile appears on her face.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: You must have already sustained defensive counterstrikes in places we can't see, right?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: As I realized that no system would ignore a threat like you, a strategy to deal with you dawned on me. I can destroy your underlying logic and completely erase your existence.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: But... our Chief wants you alive. He seems to like you quite a bit.
steps.female_content: But... our Chief wants you alive. She seems to like you quite a bit.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: So I had to take a different approach, go on a slight detour, and bet on this virus. It would be best if I could capture you in one piece.

000 tries to speak, but her body starts flickering. Her voice distorts and gets mixed with other fragmented utterances. She steps forward, but her movements stutter, causing her face to intermittently pixelate and flash unfamiliar faces.

After repeating this a few times, she gets enraged and summons a halo blade, slashing it into her own body. With a high-pitched screech, her distorted afterimages shake violently, causing a shockwave to crash into the firewall in front of you.
A few seconds later, the chaotic malfunction finally subsides. 000 regains her composure, but she's no longer in control of the situation.
...No, this isn't a virus... What did you do?
Her anger doesn't affect Moore at all. Instead, the tech expert is happily recording all of 000's abnormal responses, seemingly impressed by her reaction.
Only when asked does she remember that she is still in front of the enemy.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Yes, I know you've obtained those "godly" permissions. Any low-dimensional virus I create wouldn't amount to so much as a scratch before being brushed off.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: I just used it to buy some more time.
000 realizes something, but her body can no longer follow her commands. Something is seizing control of herself from within.
Moore watches all this coldly.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: You were born from the rarest loophole in the system. It's a brilliant miracle, but also the source of your misfortune.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: You lived but became an error that no world could tolerate. You were only able to rely on system loopholes to survive as well.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Your very existence is already a paradox. As a low-dimensional programmer, I can't fix your problem.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: But fortunately, someone can.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: CharacterSettings_000.xlsx, right?
000 looks at her and answers word by word.
...You can't possibly have modification permissions.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: No, I don't. Want to see who does?
[Scene Change] Writer Duck work desk
In the middle of the night, a figure leans on the bed, typing away quickly on a tablet.

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content:
Quack quack quack... Quack! Quack quack quack. 
(000... 000... found it! Such an old file...)

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack... Quack quack quack quack... Quack quack quack.
(Didn't expect boss to like this type. How ancient is this version? It's so hard to modify... Why did they assign me to do it, and in such a hurry, too...)

steps.speaker: Bagel
steps.content:
Quack, quack quack quack... 
(...Hmm, I'll ask Rise for advice...)
(Scene change)
Rise looks at the comms channel in disbelief, finally realizing what her "intelligence" was used for.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: ...It's her?
In another world, in a programmer's tiny apartment, Moore presses Enter to confirm the final command... and the task is complete.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: It's all settled. I've found a solution for you.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: The source of your misfortunes consists of being forgotten by your creator, illegally taken, and spawned where you shouldn't exist. Now, the gods' gaze has finally fallen upon you.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: It will embrace your flaws and mistakes, giving you a complete life. From now on, you won't have to worry about being expelled from the world. No one will hunt you down to erase you.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Your existence will be acknowledged. Soon, you'll have your own fate, and an ego that will be recognized.

Moore congratulates her, but there's a hint of regret in her eyes. After so many years exploring the web and conducting so many tests, she finally found such a special case, sample, and unexpected gain.
She wishes she could keep 000 a little longer. Maybe she'll try to control her and train her, to see how far she could go.
...What a pity. This girl grew up too fast and became too strong-willed, threatening the safety of Chief. Moore can only make short work of this little bug before 000 causes more damage.
Oh well. Moore seals the last data record and closes the process monitor. Finally, she won't have to pull any more all-nighters. She yawns and shifts her voice to a warmer tone.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: You can stop worrying too, Chief. From now on, she can be a normal Sinner and your companion, just like everyone else.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: In a bit, you can take her back to the Bureau with your shackles.
The prolonged rewind battle has exhausted you greatly. Your mind struggles to take in what they're saying, but even so, you're clear about one thing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's not over yet... I can't subdue her as she is now.
In front of you, 000's silhouette keeps dissolving, yet she shows no sign of defeat. More and more data spill out from the cracks in her body.
000 lowers her head, laughing quietly yet fanatically. Her laughter pierces the unbreakable firewall Moore built, faintly unsettling you.
Hahaha... Hahahaha... I've been preparing myself and mustering up the courage to fight against this world.
But I never expected it to end like this...
This is it... Being sent off by my creator. My death feels like my birth.
Yet you...
She looks at Moore.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Mm-hmm?
You're quite something... Are you not shaken at all after seeing the truth?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Hmm... I don't feel anything. Every day, all kinds of information are input, but how to process, select and use them is determined by programming.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Do you need my help?
Hehe, so that's how it is... that's what you're like...
...Save it. Death is no news to me.
000 stands up, wobbling.
I've been too cautious in the past, too eager to preserve that hard-won hope. I've been tiptoeing around like a flinching coward. What a joke I've become.
Around her, the air gradually becomes granular and pixelated, turning into specks of light that gather in her slowly raised right hand. They mix and resonate with her fragmented, dissipating body.
...Then, three dazzling halo blades form, and you hear a shrill alarm from Moore's side of the comms.
Thanks for backing me into a corner, so that I can let loose and have a real good time!
[Transition, special sound effects]
The halos swiftly destroys the first firewall, then the second and the third. Only the fourth firewall manages to block it, but barely.
With a flash of white light, 000 disappears from your sight, leaving behind only constant vibrations that signal the havoc she's wreaking elsewhere.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Oh dear... even at a time like this, you still want to mess around with the system... I can't be held accountable for what happens next.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Are you worried about her, Chief?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: It's okay, it's over. After all, these are the rules she trusts the most, which she can't overturn. Let's get ready to go back, shall we?
Saying this, she types on her keyboard several times, and the "game entrance" lights up on the screen.
[Game Icon]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I can go back now?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But right now...

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Even if you let things be, a "normal" Sinner will soon come to your side, just as you requested.
The Mania storm outside is still raging, gradually interfering with Moore's comms. The game entrance becomes unstable. You know you should hurry up. But...
[Illustration] 000 with battle damage on her eye(s)
Thinking of 000's final frantic actions, you can't find peace.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I must find her now. Knowing her, she won't give up just like this. It won't end here.
Instead of going into the entrance, you release your shackles with all your might...
[Release the shackles]
[Black Screen]
The moment the shackles break through the firewall, the comms get completely cut off. Moore sits alone in the room, staring at the darkened monitor.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Hehe... it's too late now.
